decisions.reason: As an organic extension of the firm’s established salami expertise, this product fits existing knowledge and the stated expansion of organic lines, so the firm can credibly refine and commercialise it with limited additional learning risk.

This organic poultry snack is close enough to the firm’s core meat-processing and seasoning capabilities while also serving a growth format, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to improve it and scale it in a growing market.

A premium salami snack for sharing builds directly on the firm’s traditional charcuterie know-how and premium positioning, making it a low-distance innovation that the firm is well equipped to evaluate and develop further.
